[ISBK.1.7] **ABI evolution.** libds adds vtable fields only at the tail and
bumps `DS_SERIES_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION` when it does. Every backend is libds's own
and is built with the header it registers against ([NSBK.2.3]), so an
integrator never meets a mismatch through a backend. libds still checks each
backend's `abi_version` at registration, and a mismatch fails engine
construction with `DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION` ([NSBK.2]).
